signals: Kubernetes for large GPU research clusters
blob storage for datasets and checkpoints
Triton-style custom GPU kernels for performance-critical operators

components.name: containerized_runtime
components.purpose: Make training and eval commands reproducible across local machines and clusters.
components.next_step: Build CPU and CUDA-tagged images in CI.

components.name: kubernetes_training_job
components.purpose: Run the existing trainer as a restartable cluster job with persistent data and checkpoint volumes.
components.next_step: Parameterize image, GPU count, PVC names, and node selectors per cluster.

components.name: distributed_training
components.purpose: Move from one-process training to torchrun/FSDP or DeepSpeed-style multi-GPU jobs.
components.next_step: Add a torchrun entrypoint and checkpoint compatibility tests before using multiple nodes.

components.name: checkpoint_storage
components.purpose: Save latest, best, and step checkpoints; later sync them to blob storage.
components.next_step: Add object-store upload/download hooks with checksum validation.

components.name: metrics_and_monitoring
components.purpose: Record JSONL metrics for loss, accuracy, gradient norm, perplexity, and throughput.
components.next_step: Expose metrics to Prometheus or convert metrics.jsonl into Prometheus textfile format.

components.name: gpu_health_checks
components.purpose: Catch unhealthy GPU hosts before training and quarantine them in cluster runs.
components.next_step: Add optional DCGM/NVML preflight checks in the Kubernetes job environment.

components.name: data_pipeline_manifest
components.purpose: Track data sources, filters, dedupe, exclusions, and eval contamination controls.
components.next_step: Emit per-run data manifests from prepare_hf and build_chat_data.

components.name: alignment_training
components.purpose: Add preference data, supervised critique/revision, and RLAIF-style feedback loops.
components.next_step: Start with offline preference-pair scoring before adding any RL optimizer.

components.name: release_governance
components.purpose: Require gates before claiming or shipping stronger checkpoints.
components.next_step: Require benchmark_manifest entries and failure analysis for every public claim.

components.name: kernel_optimization
components.purpose: Profile bottlenecks and consider torch.compile or Triton kernels only after model scale warrants it.
components.next_step: Add operator-level profiling before writing custom kernels.
